{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/penguins.csv')

# Check the flipper_length_mm values for the rows where 'sex' is missing
missing_sex_rows = df[df['sex'].isnull()]
flipper_values_missing_sex = missing_sex_rows['flipper_length_mm']

# Check if any of these rows have missing flipper_length_mm
has_missing_flipper = flipper_values_missing_sex.isnull().sum()

# Drop the missing flipper values to get the actual observed flipper lengths in missing-sex rows
observed_flipper_missing_sex = flipper_values_missing_sex.dropna()

# Compute the mean flipper length for these rows
mean_flipper_missing_sex = observed_flipper_missing_sex.mean()

# Also compute the overall mean flipper length (excluding all missing flipper rows)
filtered_df = df.dropna(subset=['flipper_length_mm'])
overall_mean_flipper = filtered_df['flipper_length_mm'].mean()

# Compare the mean flipper length in missing-sex rows to the overall mean
mean_flipper_missing_sex, overall_mean_flipper"}
